RESULTS OF THE ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF SASOL LIMITED HELD ON
13 NOVEMBER 2026


Sasol shareholders are hereby advised of the results of the business conducted at Sasol’s annual
general meeting held on 13 November 2026.


All the resolutions were passed by the requisite majority of voting rights exercised. The results are
as follows:


1. The audited annual financial statements of the Company and the Group, the reports of the
Audit Committee, directors and external auditors, the remuneration report and policy and the
report of the Safety, Social and Ethics Committee for the financial year ended 30 June 2026,
were presented.
